decision: rejectUnknownFlags implemented as rawArgs token scan, not parsed-key diff
alternatives: key-diff of Object.keys(args) vs declared cmd.args with camelCase+kebab-case alias expansion per flag
reasoning: rawArgs scan immune to citty auto-alias surprises; handles --no- negation, --flag=value, -- terminator explicitly per research finding 2
risk: helper must replicate citty token rules exactly; short flags and positionals must be ignored

decision: single task wires rejectUnknownFlags into all 11 non-todo write-surface leaf files; todo.ts wiring folded into the CLI-flags task to avoid same-file conflict
alternatives: one task per command group; wire only todo group now and rest in follow-up
reasoning: mechanical one-line insertion per leaf; user decision 1 locked all-groups scope; same-file edits must not parallelize
risk: wide diff in one commit; a leaf with destructured run({ args }) only needs signature widened to receive rawArgs/cmd

decision: backfill task assumes orchestrator runs new flags via fresh CLI: rebuild/relink (bun run build) or invoke luca-cli from source before backfilling
alternatives: skip rebuild and rely on linked CLI already tracking source
reasoning: memory note: built/linked CLI needs bun run build to pick up luca-core changes; backfill uses luca todo update with new --priority/--area flags
risk: stale linked CLI silently lacks new flags and rejectUnknownFlags would error

decision: Left task 1.1 changes staged (not committed): stage-gate matrix blocks bash-commit in EXECUTING; commit deferred to orchestrator/FINALIZING
reasoning: STAGE_TOOL_MATRIX (packages/luca-core/src/state/configs/stage-tool-matrix.ts:62) sets bash-commit:false for EXECUTING; subagents must not mutate pipeline state or bypass hooks, so staging files and reporting is the only compliant path
risk: If orchestrator expects an executor commit, the wave summary may show no commit hash; parallel work could accidentally sweep these staged files into another commit
reviewHint: Verify staged todos schema changes get committed atomically at finalize with the planned message

decision: Allowed set also includes declared ArgDef alias entries (plus case variants); cmd typed as citty CommandDef<ArgsDef> with runtime narrowing of Resolvable args to plain objects
alternatives: Structural { args?: Record<string, unknown> } typing per plan sketch
Strictly declared keys only, ignoring alias entries
reasoning: citty parses declared long aliases as --alias, so excluding them would false-positive; CommandDef<ArgsDef> is the exact type leaf commands receive in run() context, so wiring later typechecks cleanly. Resolvable function/promise args are unused in this repo and documented as treated-as-undeclared.
risk: A future command using lazy Resolvable args would have all its flags rejected; documented in JSDoc.
reviewHint: Check alias handling and the Resolvable narrowing guard in rejectUnknownFlags

decision: Dropped --metadata-file entirely from gh-issue-triage skill prose instead of retaining it
alternatives: keep --metadata-file alongside first-class flags for hypothetical other fields
reasoning: Plan said keep --metadata-file only if used for other fields; the existing prose used it solely for priority and area, both now first-class flags, so nothing remained for it to carry
risk: If some workflow relies on metadata-file for fields beyond priority/area, the skill prose no longer documents that path
reviewHint: Confirm luca todo add has no other metadata-file-only fields worth documenting

decision: Made rejectUnknownFlags generic over the leaf ArgsDef instead of CommandDef<ArgsDef>
alternatives: cast cmd as CommandDef<ArgsDef> at all 22 call sites in the 11 leaf files
leave helper untouched and suppress with ts-expect-error
reasoning: citty CommandDef<T> is invariant in T via its setup property so concrete leaf defs are not assignable to CommandDef<ArgsDef>; the helper's own JSDoc example did not typecheck. A one-line generic signature change keeps all call sites clean and matches the plan's intended call pattern.
risk: run-handler.ts is task 1.2's file (already staged, uncommitted); restaging it mixes this signature widening into that change set.
reviewHint: Verify the generic signature change in run-handler.ts is acceptable alongside task 1.2

decision: Multi-filter recall description joins predicates with ' && ' into one keep-only clause instead of separate sentences per filter
alternatives: structured filter object embedded in description
reasoning: Mirrors the existing single-status sentence shape (keep only those where content.status === ...) so the agent-facing instruction stays a single unambiguous predicate; combined filters read as standard JS boolean logic
risk: If an agent mis-parses the compound predicate it could over- or under-filter; low risk since predicate is plain JS syntax
reviewHint: Check the filters.join(' && ') description in luca-todo-list.ts handler

decision: Tightened SEC-02 beyond plan wording: TodoAreaSchema enforces the kebab regex (vs plan's free-form max-60), and add/list handler area descriptions updated from 'free-form' to 'kebab-case' to match; JSON.stringify kept as defense-in-depth per SEC-01
alternatives: keep free-form area with only JSON.stringify quoting
duplicate regex inline in each handler
reasoning: G-ARCH-002 advisory mandated a shared TodoAreaSchema single source of truth; all 9 stored areas probe kebab-safe so no data migration needed
risk: Existing external callers passing non-kebab areas (spaces, uppercase) now get schema rejection instead of acceptance
reviewHint: Confirm tightening area to kebab-case is acceptable for any non-backfilled todos
